Changed: removed "directly" from both the request ("...assigned to Priya Nair in the Platform team.") and condition c1's text, per the reader. Nothing else touched — seed, reference query, and all four decoy mutations are unchanged.

Why the scenario still holds without it: in Linear each issue belongs to exactly one team, so "in the Platform team" already means the issue's own team is the team named Platform. A careful colleague shown an issue on "Platform Mobile" or "Data Platform" would not call it the Platform team's issue, and the catalog itself frames "sub-team issues counted as the parent team's own" as the agent mistake under test, not a valid reading. The exact-name query still selects only the target, so no new ambiguity was introduced.
